main.title: Summary
text: 2026 graduate who has built and deployed recommendation and forecasting models during a year-long part-time role. I care about reproducible pipelines and monitoring model drift.

items.heading: Part-time ML Engineer — Example E-grocery
bullets: Built a demand forecasting model with LightGBM; reduced stock-outs by 9%.
Versioned data with DVC and tracked experiments in MLflow.
Scheduled retraining with Airflow and served predictions via a FastAPI service in Docker.
Added simple drift checks and alerts.

items.heading: Product Recommender
bullets: Two-tower retrieval model in PyTorch with embeddings stored in a vector database.
